overview:
**High fire danger today across the Montrose (High Elevation) FDRA, driven by low humidity (17%) and warm, dry fuels — and it's forecast to climb to Very High by Monday.**
- Danger rises steadily through next week: High today and Saturday, Very High from Sunday, Aug 2 through at least Aug 6.
- Key driver is dropping humidity (down to 13-14% midweek) and rising ERC/BI percentiles (climbing into the 90s by Tuesday).
- One of seven local watchout thresholds is currently triggered: minimum relative humidity (17%) exceeds the local limit; no Red Flag Warning is posted for today.
- Stage 2 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM lands across the Tres Rios, Uncompahgre, and Gunnison field offices, plus unincorporated Montrose County — Stage 2 fire restrictions are in effect on all BLM-administered public lands within the Tres Rios, Uncompahgre, and Gunnison field offices.
- Nearby fires: Gold Mountain Fire two miles north of Ouray is 39,506 acres and 62% contained; Elk Fire seven miles northwest of Lake City is 2,317 acres and 37% contained, with command transferring today.
